title: Platinum Roadmap

stages.name: Story Campaign & Core Chapters
stages.description: Complete all main story chapters (Chapters 1 to 4) and narrative milestones from Gone Fishing to the penultimate chapter. Focus strictly on narrative progression across Vice City and Leonida.
checklist: Complete introductory mission 'Gone Fishing' in Vice City.
Finish Chapter 1 narrative operations and safehouse setup.
Complete Chapter 2 drug trafficking and syndicate missions.
Execute Chapter 3 high-stakes cartel and marina operations.
Finish Chapter 4 high-altitude infiltration and crew setup.
Ensure all story checkpoints and auto-saves are successfully logged.

stages.name: Missable Story Trophies & Stranger Strands
stages.description: Complete all missable story-progress trophies (Trust, Break the Bank, Family Matters, DWNFALL, Hi-Jacked, Snow Storm) and all 8 stranger mission strands (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, etc.) before campaign cutoffs.
checklist: Complete 'Breakfast Run' (Trust) before Chapter 1 cutoff.
Complete 'The Cartel Heist' and 'Child's Play' before Chapter 2 cutoff.
Complete 'Headliners' and 'VCIA Takedown' before Chapter 3 cutoff.
Complete 'Operation Savage Glory' before Chapter 4 cutoff.
Complete all multi-part stranger strands for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, and Tyrone.
Verify all missable flags are secured before transitioning to endgame free-roam.

stages.name: Collectibles, Exploration & 100% Completion
stages.description: Achieve 100% completion across Leonida. Execute 250 stunt jumps, collect trading card sets, log 100 vehicles, explore all 52 map sectors, purchase all 8 garage properties, and witness paranormal events.
checklist: Land all 250 stunt jumps across highways and rooftops.
Collect and complete 3 Trading Card sets across convenience stores.
Log 100 unique vehicles in your dossier.
Uncover all 52 map sectors across Vice City and the Everglades.
Purchase all 8 garage and safehouse properties.
Witness the paranormal Easter egg event in the Everglades.

stages.name: Activities, Challenges & Mini-games
stages.description: Earn gold medals in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations, win 20 different street races, defeat Cal at fishing, play bowling, and complete arcade games.
checklist: Earn gold medals across all 42 Ammu-Nation shooting range challenges.
Place first in Top Fun drone races at all 14 locations.
Win 20 unique street and off-road races across Leonida.
Defeat Cal in the Everglades fishing challenge.
Complete a bowling game and an arcade cabinet game.
Try each of the 9 distinct activity types at least once.

stages.name: Online & Platinum Clean-Up
stages.description: Complete remaining miscellaneous tasks including partner wanted level escapes, retail robberies, bank vault break-ins, gang stash raids, laundering marked cash, and unlock the final Platinum trophy.
checklist: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner.
Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing heat.
Rob 5 bank vaults and successfully escape the district.
Raid illegal operations run by each of the 9 rival gangs.
Launder $250,000 in marked bills through your contacts.
Unlock all 54 other trophies to claim the Platinum 'Vice Got a Price!'.

sources: Roadmap based on official trophy descriptions and community platinum progression standards
